comparisons.reason: Both measure any-comment quotation of OP title/argument text with the same sources, exclusions and empty-list rule. Their null rules differ, though. Spec 0 returns null only when title AND argument are both missing. Spec 84 returns null when 'title/argument is missing', which reads as either one missing, so no negative can be established. If only one OP field is missing and no quote is found, 0 gives 0 and 84 likely gives null. The boundary is unresolved, so the measurements are not safely interchangeable.
